scope: 3D visualization, RGB signed color scale, optional real panel edges, and visible aerodynamic solve progress. Numerical solvers unchanged.

cases: Swept, dihedral, twisted NACA 4415 to 0012 wing
independent_checks.rgb_endpoints_and_zero: blue at minimum; green at zero; red at maximum
independent_checks.mismatched_mesh: Refused instead of coloring the wrong geometry
browser: Actual sample solve at V=18 m/s, alpha=5 deg
Lower-surface click reports its signed Cp and pressure
Keyboard rotation changes the rendered view
Show panels toggles aerodynamic panel edges
PNG export contains the 3D view and panel edges
Solve-progress card displays worker mesh stage and elapsed time
Progress card disappears when the aerodynamic solve completes

physics_note: A positive trailing-edge Cp is not by itself a Kutta violation. Kutta requires the upper/lower trailing-edge pressures to match, not Cp=0. The RGB update does not replace or force the computed Cp values.
source: The 3D viewer reconstructs the base mesh with WingAeroPanel.wingMesh and places each stored Cp on its original panel. It does not run another aerodynamic solve.
limitations: Cp is from the base mesh, not the extrapolated pressure field.
Potential flow has no viscous drag or stall/separation prediction.
This release does not add a shell or solid FE solver.
